title: AnestheSIM: an open, extensible patient simulator for closed-loop anesthesia driven by VitalDB records
description: AnestheSIM is an open MATLAB/Simulink patient simulator for closed-loop anesthesia research and teaching, in which acquisition from the VitalDB open surgical database is a native, extensible layer. Recorded or designed pump rates and end-tidal gas concentrations drive covariate pharmacokinetic models of propofol, remifentanil and norepinephrine, three interchangeable BIS interaction models, an intravenous-inhalational model for sevoflurane and desflurane, and MAP/HR models, all with published parameters. The release includes cohort search, automatic inhaled-agent resolution, alarms, synthetic patients, unit tests and the scripts that validate the simulator on VitalDB records.
